correctness.rationale: Two explicit neighborhood domination folds per ladder pair reduce Ind(L_n) integrally to a sphere. Four folds in B_n yield two rung factors plus B_{n-4}; base cases determine integral link homotopy. The relative chain is the augmented chain of B_n shifted by two. In the nontrivial n=4k+3 connecting-map case, a crosspolytope join cycle and maximal independent-face cocycles prove primitive degree ±1. Integral exact sequence therefore yields the complete torsion-free homology pattern. Independently enumerated mod-two cases n=4..10 and verified fold graphs support, but do not replace, these arguments.

The theorem provides a uniform infinite-family integral classification and differentiates one-versus-two surviving classes from complete disappearance in a fourth residue class.
